frozen_protocol.selection_scope: OLD S-series AI labels only; this old-fold result is not a new accuracy claim

development_selection_not_independent_ac.selection_rule: On OLD development only: reject more noncontours than legacy with no additional missed baseline-kept AI contour IDs; maximize rejected noncontours, then retained contours, then prefer fewer features.
limitations: OLD development folds are reused to select a method, not an independent performance claim.

Chains group existing touching arms for features only; no geometry is changed or gap filled.
New evaluation still shares three source sheets; it is not external geographic validation.
AI provisional labels, not human ground truth.
Line identities are new but source sheets and nearby image contexts are not independent.

rules: AI labels and model scores are not copied into editable human decision fields.
E-series cases remain evaluation-only; never train or calibrate on them.
Original target geometry is immutable evidence. Draw corrections separately.
Observed contours, inferred gap links, negative traces and unreadable masks are separate supervision types.
Nothing is approved at packet creation; named explicit human approval is required.

selection_provenance_not_human_labels.purpose: selection provenance only; inspect after human judgment to reduce suggestion bias

training_readiness.geometry_supervision: Sparse observed/corrected paths exported separately; inferred gaps and E-series excluded, unmarked pixels remain unknown.

visual_review: all 27 source-only E-series pages before forward model scores

limitations: AI provisional source labels are not human ground truth; no population accuracy claim.
Forward line UIDs do not overlap S-series, but sheets, tiles, and nearby image context are shared; not an independent geographic test.
Ten candidate trials were selected on old development data only; E labels/outcomes never entered fitting or threshold/model-family selection.
Candidate retention evaluates only existing Ink lines, not missing ink or all incorrect original joins.
Human priority cases were selected for ambiguity/decision changes, and controls were selected using provisional AI class strata; the packet is not a representative accuracy sample.
All 90 actual review cases remain unreviewed; no human-trained model exists yet.
Named human attestation is validated but the software cannot verify the identity of the UI operator.
Corrected paths and unknown/ignore masks are prepared as separate supervision; no neural path learner has been trained.
E-series and inferred-gap traces are excluded from training. The base language model is not permanently retrained by this workflow.
Earlier export/prototype folders are preserved locally but only human-review-ready is the handoff target.
